tuning_note: Swept 2026-08-01 over tau in {0,2,4,6,8} x kappa in {0.00..0.40 step 0.05, then 0.26..0.32 step 0.01}; the selection tier was the direct+colloquial half of routing_questions.json only (168 questions), on which the chosen point (tau=2.0, kappa=0.30) abstains on exactly 1 question. The oblique tier, oblique_holdout.json and oos_questions.json were not consulted in the choice; their values are reported afterwards by run.py --sweep. tau does almost no work here by design: the out-of-scope set is composed so that >= 25 of its questions out-score the median in-scope direct question (C20), so raw score alone cannot separate them and the IDF-coverage floor kappa is the operative signal. Measured at the chosen point: M1-direct 1.000, M1-coll 0.889, M1b 0.722, M1b' 0.583, M2a 0.975, M2a_near 1.000, M2b 0.027.
